questions.explanation_zh_hk: Saira 記得紅色，母親卻說是藍色。

questions.prompt: Why can the photograph not confirm the colour?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 黑白相片不能證實顏色。

questions.prompt: What is Jon’s view of memory?

options.text: It can combine details while preserving genuine feelings

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 他認為記憶會重組片段，但獨立感仍可真實。

script.speaker: Patrick
script.text: I used to say I learned to swim during a seaside holiday, but my sister insists it happened at the council pool.

script.speaker: Elena
script.text: Do you remember the water or what people told you later?

script.speaker: Patrick
script.text: Mostly the smell of chlorine and my father holding out a striped towel. That supports my sister, doesn’t it?

script.speaker: Elena
script.text: Probably, although seaside pools also use chlorine. The towel may be a stronger clue if it appears in family photos from that period.

questions.prompt: Where does Patrick’s sister say he learned?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 姐姐堅持事情發生在市營泳池。

questions.prompt: Which memory seems to support her account?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 氯氣味較符合泳池情境，但並非絕對證據。

questions.prompt: Why is Elena cautious?

options.text: Seaside pools can also smell of chlorine

questions.explanation_zh_hk: Elena 指海邊泳池亦使用氯，因此不能單憑氣味確定。

script.speaker: Councillor
script.text: Our survey shows residents want to recycle, yet a quarter of collected material is contaminated.

script.speaker: Resident
script.text: The labels differ between flats, street bins and the council website. Motivation isn’t the only issue.

script.speaker: Councillor
script.text: We’re designing one set of pictures for every location and adding feedback tags to rejected bins.

script.speaker: Resident
script.text: Good. But tags should explain the mistake politely; otherwise people may feel blamed and give up.

questions.prompt: What proportion of recycling is contaminated?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 調查顯示四分之一收集物受到污染。

questions.prompt: What cause does the resident identify?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 不同地點和網站的標籤不一致，造成混亂。

questions.prompt: Why should rejection tags be polite?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 責備語氣可能令人放棄回收。

script.speaker: Headteacher
script.text: Air readings are highest during the morning drop-off, so we propose closing the road for forty minutes.

script.speaker: Parent
script.text: That may shift cars to the next street rather than reduce them. Some parents drive because they continue to work outside town.

script.speaker: Headteacher
script.text: We could create a drop-off point near the ring road and run a supervised walking group.

script.speaker: Parent
script.text: I’d support a trial if the school measures surrounding streets as well as the gate.

questions.prompt: When are pollution readings highest?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 校門早上接送時段錄得最高污染。

questions.prompt: What unintended effect worries the parent?

options.text: Traffic moving to a nearby street

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 封路可能只把車流轉移到下一條街。

questions.prompt: Under what condition will the parent support a trial?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 家長要求同時監測周邊街道。

script.speaker: Interviewer
script.text: You argue that remote work can strengthen small towns. Isn’t isolation a serious drawback?

script.speaker: Beth
script.text: It can be. My point is not that everyone should stay home, but that fewer long commutes leave time for local activities.

script.speaker: Interviewer
script.text: Only if workers use that time locally.

script.speaker: Beth
script.text: Exactly. That’s why shared workspaces matter: they offer social contact and bring customers to nearby cafés without requiring a journey to the city.

questions.prompt: What claim is Beth actually making?

options.text: Reduced commuting can free time for local life
Everyone should work alone at home

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 她並非主張人人留家，而是減少通勤可騰出社區時間。

questions.prompt: What limitation does the interviewer raise?

options.text: Saved time may not benefit the town

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 只有當人們在本地使用所省時間，社區才受惠。

questions.prompt: Why does Beth favour shared workspaces?

options.text: They combine social contact with local spending
They remove the need for cafés

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 共享工作間既減少孤立，也為附近商戶帶來顧客。

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: Your topic is the return of museum objects. Do you think every object should go back to its country of origin?

script.speaker: Malik
script.text: A single rule would ignore how objects were acquired and what present communities want. Each case needs transparent evidence.

script.speaker: Tutor
script.text: Could long-term loans be a compromise?

script.speaker: Malik
script.text: Sometimes, but calling a loan a solution can preserve unequal ownership. Museums should first speak with the communities concerned, not decide the compromise alone.

questions.prompt: Why does Malik reject one universal rule?

options.text: Cases have different histories and community wishes

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 物件取得方式和當代社群意願各異。

questions.prompt: What concern does he have about long-term loans?

options.text: They may leave unequal ownership unchanged

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 借展可能看似解決，實際仍維持不平等擁有權。

questions.prompt: Who should be consulted first?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 他強調先與相關社群對話。

script.speaker: Examiner
script.text: You say public transport should be free. Wouldn’t that be unfair to people who rarely use it?

script.speaker: Lina
script.text: I understand the objection, but roads are also funded by people who do not drive. The wider benefit is less congestion and cleaner air.

script.speaker: Examiner
script.text: Are those benefits guaranteed?

script.speaker: Lina
script.text: No. Free fares must be combined with frequent, reliable services; otherwise existing passengers benefit but few drivers change their habits.

questions.prompt: What objection does the examiner raise?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 提問質疑少用公共交通者亦需承擔費用是否公平。

questions.prompt: How does Lina respond initially?

options.text: She compares it with shared road funding

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 她以非駕駛者也資助道路作類比。

questions.prompt: What condition is necessary to change drivers’ habits?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: Lina 說免費車資必須配合頻密可靠班次。

script.speaker: Examiner
script.text: If your local market closed, how might the area change?

script.speaker: Theo
script.text: At first, supermarkets would gain customers, but the social effect could be greater than the economic one.

script.speaker: Examiner
script.text: In what sense?

script.speaker: Theo
script.text: The market is where new residents meet long-term neighbours. Without it, the area would lose an informal meeting place, even if another shop sold the same food.

questions.prompt: What does “in what sense?” ask Theo to do?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 考官要求他具體解釋「社會影響較大」的意思。

questions.prompt: Who currently meet at the market?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 市場讓新居民與長期街坊相遇。

questions.prompt: Why can another food shop not fully replace it?

options.text: The market also serves as a meeting place

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 相同商品不能取代其非正式社交功能。

script.speaker: Manager
script.text: The 8:40 train is cancelled. The next direct service arrives after the first conference session begins.

script.speaker: Delegate
script.text: Could I take the 9:05 to Reading and change there?

script.speaker: Manager
script.text: Yes, but the connection is only six minutes. If you miss it, you’ll arrive even later than on the direct train.

script.speaker: Delegate
script.text: Then I’ll take the direct service and join the opening session online from the train. Please tell the organiser I’ll be there for the workshop.

questions.prompt: What risk comes with changing at Reading?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 轉車只有六分鐘，錯過便更遲。

questions.prompt: Which journey does the delegate choose?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 他決定乘下一班直達車。

questions.prompt: How will the delegate handle the opening session?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 他會在列車上網上參與開場環節。

script.speaker: Chair
script.text: We can fund either the youth theatre’s equipment or the garden group’s accessible paths, not both in full.

script.speaker: Committee member
script.text: The theatre could borrow lights from the college, whereas the paths cannot be created without materials.

script.speaker: Chair
script.text: So give the garden the full amount and reject the theatre?

script.speaker: Committee member
script.text: Not necessarily. Fund the paths, then offer the theatre a smaller grant for transport to the college. That supports both aims, though not both original requests.

questions.prompt: Why is the garden project harder to do without funding?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 無材料便不能興建無障礙通道。

questions.prompt: What does the committee member propose for the theatre?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 建議給較小款項，用於前往學院借燈的交通。

questions.prompt: What principle guides the proposal?

options.text: Support both aims by adapting the requests

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 方案調整用途，使兩個目標均獲支援。

script.speaker: Host
script.text: Your study proves that listening to music improves everyone’s concentration.

script.speaker: Dr Reed
script.text: I need to correct that. We found a small improvement among adults doing familiar tasks, not among every participant or every kind of work.

script.speaker: Host
script.text: So should offices play music?

script.speaker: Dr Reed
script.text: The study cannot answer that. Participants chose their own music and used headphones; a shared office playlist would be a different condition.

questions.prompt: What does Dr Reed correct?

options.text: The host has generalised the findings too far

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 研究只在特定成人及熟悉任務中發現小幅改善，不能推廣至所有人。

questions.prompt: Which condition was used in the study?

options.text: Participants chose music and wore headphones

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 參與者自行選歌並用耳機。

questions.prompt: Why can the study not justify office playlists?

options.text: A shared playlist is a different condition

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 集體播放與實驗條件不同，不能直接推論。

script.speaker: Organiser
script.text: Before opening, test every donated appliance for electrical safety. A green label means it passed last month, but check the date rather than assuming it is current.

script.speaker: Volunteer
script.text: What if an item fails but the fault looks simple?

script.speaker: Organiser
script.text: Move it to the red shelf and record the fault. Do not repair electrical items until Kamal, our qualified technician, arrives.

script.speaker: Volunteer
script.text: Understood. I can examine torn clothing meanwhile because that station does not require him.

questions.prompt: Why must volunteers check green-label dates?

options.text: A previous test may no longer be current

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 綠標只代表上月曾通過，仍需核對日期。

questions.prompt: What happens to a failed appliance first?

options.text: It goes on the red shelf and is recorded
It is returned without a note

questions.explanation_zh_hk: 失敗物品先移至紅架並記錄故障。

questions.prompt: Which work can the volunteer do before Kamal arrives?
questions.explanation_zh_hk: 衣物站不需要合資格電器技師。
